question: How much additional rational-lift and relation yield does a frozen rational-x denominator search buy over the integer-x window?
fields: all eight selected fields in input order
subgroup_generator: same m times reduction of P=(2,2) as the parent window
target: Q=17G, fixture scalar used only for replay
query_law: complete t in [0,q), R_t=Q-tG; pair law is independent ordered t1,t2 in [0,q)^2
point_admission: both reduced points nonidentity and distinct

lift_rule.candidate: a0 is the centered residue of x(R)*d^2 mod p; a=a0+shift*p; x_Q=a/d^2; b^2=a^3-a*d^4-2*d^6; y_Q=b/d^3
lift_rule.acceptance: first coprime a,d with exact nonnegative square and b/d^3 reducing to public y
lift_rule.probe_charge: every inspected (d,shift) pair, including gcd and square failures

relation_family: all ordered (a,b) with 1<=a<=3, 1<=abs(b)<=3, gcd(a,abs(b))=1; lexicographic a,b
raw_rows: one deterministic gzip JSONL file per field, including every failed point lift
claim_boundary: bounded public-coordinate rational-x lift diagnostic, with point-wise reuse; no isolated timing or complete rational-lift claim
